Text_SeismicTossTeach:
The secrets of space… The mysteries of earth…
There are so many things about which we know so little.
But that should spur us to study harder, not toss in the towel.
The only thing you should toss…
Well, how about SEISMIC TOSS? Should I teach that to a POKéMON?
Text_SeismicTossDeclined: Is that so? I'm sure you'll be back for it.
Text_SeismicTossWhichMon: Which POKéMON wants to learn SEISMIC TOSS?
Text_SeismicTossTaught: I hope you won't toss in the towel. Keep it up.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WhatsSpecialAb:
MOON STONE, huh?
What's so special about it? Looks like an ordinary rock to me.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BoughtColorTVF:
July 20, 1969!
Humankind first set foot on the moon that day.
I bought a color TV just so I could watch that news.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_RunningSpaceEx: This month, we're running a space exhibit.

I want a PIKACHU! It's so cute!
I asked my daddy to catch me one!
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PikachuSoonIPr: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_MeteoriteThatF: A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON. It is thought to be a MOON STONE.
